justification: The strongest correspondence is the distinctive upper row of repeated arched/handled rectangular motifs placed above a patterned horizontal band, with schematic profile creatures occupying the area below. The main difference is that A is a crowded, roughly symmetrical composition with multiple overlapping or facing figures and large flanking forms, while B is more clearly divided into vertical registers with fewer, more isolated profile animals.
